item.title: Beware Of The 'Fanum Tax' Coming To Get You This Christmas Adam Because It's The Meme's Anniversary Today
item.description: Fanum Tax refers to a running gag a part of Twitch streamer Fanum's streams in which he "taxes" other AMP members like Kai Cenat when they're eating food, taking a small part of their meal.
